name: Pinpoint Pulse
description: Up to 8 pulsing targets; click them before they fade. Centre hits pay extra.

name: Pinpoint Sudden Death
description: Pinpoint Pulse with no time limit: the first miss or lost target ends the run.

name: Pixel Dot
description: One tiny dot at a time. Precision, reaction and path bonuses.

name: Hub & Line
description: Touch the hub before each click; straight paths and centre hits pay. Targets shrink as you hit.

name: Wide Line
description: Large static targets; straight paths and centre hits pay. Targets shrink as you hit.

name: Triple Bonus
description: Pulsing targets with big precision, reaction and path bonuses.

name: Hub Flick
description: Flick out from the hub to a pulsing target, then come back.

name: Pair Sweep
description: Two targets at once: clear the pair, long straight sweeps pay.

name: Trio Sweep
description: Three targets at once: clear the set with clean paths.

name: Swarm Sweep
description: Sets that grow from 2 up to 20 targets over the run.

name: Pair Sweep Timed
description: Pairs that vanish after 0.8 s; distance pays, losses cost.

name: Hub Reflex
description: Touch the hub, then react to the next static target. Speed and path pay.

name: Quick Reflex
description: Static targets appear one at a time; fast, straight clicks pay.

name: Small Reflex
description: Small targets after a 1 s pause; reaction and precision pay.

name: Wait & Click
description: A centre target appears after a random wait. Ten tries; early clicks cost a second.

name: Wait & Flick
description: Like Wait & Click, but the target can appear anywhere.

name: Wait & Pair
description: After a random wait, clear two targets as fast as you can. Ten sets.

name: Wait & Trio
description: After a random wait, clear three targets as fast as you can. Ten sets.

name: Clear 200
description: 200 targets on screen: clear them all against the clock. Misses add a second.

name: Waves 150
description: Three waves of 50 targets against the clock. Misses add 0.1 s.

name: Drift 200
description: 200 hits on slowly drifting targets.

name: Chase Fast
description: Keep the cursor on a large, fast-strafing target. Points per tick on target.

name: Chase Steady
description: Keep the cursor on a small, smoothly strafing target.

name: Chase Switch
description: Stay on a target until it breaks, then switch to the next. Targets shrink.

name: Chase Strafe
description: A target that strafes hard left and right; stay on it.

name: Orbit Chaos
description: Pulsing targets that orbit and strafe at the same time.

name: Speed Up
description: One target that gets faster with every hit. Misses cost a lot.
